visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing sunglasses and a gray t-shirt stands outside 'Hotel JAL City Fukuoka Tenjin', pulling a light blue suitcase. He smiles at the camera as yellow and black text overlays appear. (2) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the man eating various Japanese dishes including ramen and a beef intestine hotpot in indoor restaurant settings. (3) The man visits Kushida Shrine, pointing at large, ornate traditional floats. He later walks through Maizuru Park and Ohori Park during the daytime and sunset, with lush greenery and lake backgrounds. (4) A digital interface section appears, showing the Rakuten Travel app on a smartphone screen, displaying hotel search results and prices. (5) The man visits a bakery named 'Dacomeca', showing a close-up of a cream-filled pastry, then takes a boat to a cat island where he is seen petting several cats on the pavement. (6) Evening scenes at a street food stall (Yatai) show him sharing food with another male companion. (7) On the final day, he visits Kokura Castle and Mojiko Port, wearing a striped polo shirt. He is also seen in a traditional Japanese costume inside the castle. (8) The video concludes with him at Nokonoshima Island at sunset and then at the airport, followed by a collage of travel photos.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator (Joeman), 1 male companion in the middle, and various passers-by/diners in the background throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is an East Asian male with short dark hair, seen wearing various casual outfits: a gray t-shirt, a black tank top, a pink button-down shirt over a white tee, and a blue and white striped polo shirt. He often wears black-framed sunglasses or clear-framed glasses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Diverse locations across Fukuoka, Japan, including the modern exterior of JAL City Hotel, traditional shrine grounds with tall floats, scenic waterfront parks with willow trees, various cozy indoor restaurant interiors, the deck of a passenger ferry, the historic stone walls of Kokura Castle, and the European-style architecture of Mojiko Station.

(4) A digital UI 'click' or 'ding' sound accompanies the transition to the mobile app showcase. (5) Background ambient noise shifts to a low-frequency hum and wind noise during boat scenes, though narration remains dominant. (6) Brief muffled chatter and clinking of dishes are heard during the Yatai stall scenes. (7) A subtle 'whoosh' sound marks the transition between different travel locations. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Chronological Travel Diary -> Product Integration -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel guide and personal vlog documenting a 100-hour solo trip to Fukuoka, while also acting as a promotional advertisement for Rakuten Travel's hotel booking services in Japan. It aims to inspire viewers with high-quality food and scenic imagery while providing a practical call-to-action for travel planning.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator dedicates a significant middle portion of the video to showcasing the Rakuten Travel app interface, explaining its benefits, and recommending it as the top booking site for Japan.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production-value travel vlog with seamless commercial integration. The rapid editing pace and multi-modality cues (text, voice, BGM) create a high-density information flow characteristic of top-tier social media content.
